title: Roasted Vegetable Tagine with Honeyed Dates
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian tagine recipe featuring roasted vegetables and sweet honeyed dates. Perfect for a comforting lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cut the carrots, bell peppers, and onion into large chunks.
In a large bowl, toss the vegetables with cumin, paprika, and a pinch of salt.
Transfer the vegetables to a baking sheet and roast for 25-30 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the dates by slicing them in half lengthwise.
In a small saucepan, heat the honey over medium heat until it starts to bubble.
Add the sliced dates to the honey and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
To assemble the tagine, place the roasted vegetables in a large serving dish.
Arrange the honeyed dates on top of the vegetables.
